decisions.reason: As a men's care line that builds on the firm's existing natural-cosmetics know-how and was launched as a broader series, it fits the firm's related knowledge base well enough that management would more likely keep and refine it despite limited later website evidence.

A facial cleansing foam is very close to the firm's established skincare range, so absorptive-capacity logic implies the firm can best interpret market feedback and improve it, making continuation more likely than withdrawal.
